frozen.name: F_flatten_noLLM_v1
frozen.decision: Primary architecture = F (flatten head, no LLM). Evidence: S1 E vs F, ETTh1 H=96, alpha=0, seeds 42/123/456 under one protocol: F had lower test MSE on 3/3 seeds (0.3752 +- 0.0028 vs 0.3898 +- 0.0059; paired E-F +0.0082..+0.0209), lower validation MSE on 3/3 seeds, 5.2x less time per epoch (80 s vs 415 s on a T4) and 4.7x less GPU memory (1.84 vs 8.67 GB). E (GPT-2) is retained as a documented secondary variant, not used in the main study.

architecture.positional_embeddings: TD and FD, added once before self-attention

training.test_evaluation: once, after training, on the selected checkpoint

frozen.hardware: Kaggle, 2x Tesla T4 (one run per GPU)

metrics.primary: test RMSE (z-scored space, all windows x steps x variables)

frozen.supervisor_decision: Nov 1, 2026, Option 3: (1) verify E/F and run the 3-seed paired comparison [done: S1]; (2) freeze F as the efficient model for the main scheduler study unless the paired comparison gives a clear reason to choose E [none: F better on 3/3 seeds]; (3) full scheduler study on F with the calibrated fixed alpha as the critical comparator; (4) confirm the key scheduler result on E with paired seeds; (5) decide title, framing and claims from the evidence.

confirmation_model.name: E_flatten_gpt2_normspos_v1
confirmation_model.use: step 4 only: confirm the key scheduler result with paired seeds (same protocol)

protocol.stage: S3: does the auxiliary TFB objective help? (H1)

arms.alpha_0: re-used from Stage 2 (same code in src/, same configuration and seeds; Stage 2 showed bit-identical results across Kaggle sessions for seeds 42/123/456)

protocol.grid_rationale: log-spaced over two decades; at alpha = 1 the weighted TFB term (~1.9) is about six times the task loss (~0.33), at alpha = 0.01 it is about 6 % of it; 0.3 is the weight used in all earlier experiments
protocol.seeds: the 10 predeclared seeds of the frozen configuration
protocol.training: identical to Stage 2: Adam 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4, batch 32, <= 30 epochs, early stopping patience 5 (min 5), best-validation checkpoint, test evaluated once
protocol.alpha_star_selection: alpha* = the arm (alpha = 0 included) with the lowest MEAN best-validation MSE over the 10 seeds. Validation only; test results are never used for selection. Averaging over seeds is required because Stage 2 showed validation and test MSE are not rank-correlated across seeds (rho = -0.21).
protocol.primary_test: paired by seed: test RMSE of alpha* minus alpha = 0. Wilcoxon signed-rank (two-sided) and paired permutation test (10 000 sign flips); 95 % bootstrap CI of the mean paired difference; Cliff's delta
protocol.secondary: each fixed alpha vs alpha = 0 (Holm-corrected over the 5 comparisons); dose-response of validation and test error against alpha; whether the TFB loss is actually reduced by training (train_tfb with alpha > 0 vs alpha = 0); MAE, SMAPE, per-step and per-variable MSE

decision_rule.H1_supported: alpha* > 0 AND alpha* has lower test RMSE than alpha = 0 with p < 0.05 (Wilcoxon) AND the bootstrap CI of the paired difference excludes 0
decision_rule.practically_meaningful: mean improvement larger than the seed-to-seed sd of alpha = 0 (Stage 2: 0.0028 MSE)
decision_rule.H1_not_supported: otherwise. Per the research plan the scheduler study (S4) is then NOT started; the central premise is reassessed with the supervisor first
decision_rule.fixed_alpha_is_a_meaningful_baseline: if alpha* > 0, the calibrated fixed alpha* is the critical comparator of S4
